inclusion_rule: Studies that decode speech or text from a non-acoustic speech signal (lip or face video, articulatory imaging, EMG, EEG/ECoG/intracortical) and train the signal encoder against a speaker, subject or session classifier (gradient reversal, entropy-maximising or confusion loss, mutual-information penalty, or a VAE split of identity and content) to remove identity from the content representation. Boundary: GAN discriminators on the generated audio, plain multi-speaker training, and speaker classifiers used only for evaluation are excluded; versions count once; the pattern match is an upper bound.
